reasons: The cited text (p0013) does impose a sole-source purchasing restriction on Customer for the full term with no reduction or exit right, which falls within the rule's scope (volume/purchasing restrictions on Customer amounting to a de facto commitment), so 'deviation' is the correct status.

The redline is the smallest effective edit: it deletes only the single-sentence exclusivity obligation, leaving compliant Sections 2.1 and 7.1 intact, and reaches the preferred position (fees for ordered/used Services only).
Deletion also cures the internal conflict with Section 12.3, which expressly records that Customer has made no exclusivity or minimum-volume commitment, so no ambiguity is introduced by the removal.

The comment is accurate, concise, first-person plural, carries the [Playbook] prefix, states what changed and why, cites the playbook position, and offers a workable alternative (non-binding forecasts) without lecturing.
Deterministic check confirms the operation applies; the full-paragraph change ratio is justified because the paragraph contains nothing other than the offending obligation.
